details:
Versions published since 2026-07 contain a stub 'share compute swarm' functionality for 'faster results'. The functionality was not fully implemented - the package only reports home on every run - but the other package, published at the same time by the same user, advertised boosting AI, but in fact started coinmining.


---

Category: HIGHLY_SUSPICIOUS - Packages that are likely malicious, but due to the obfuscation level, lack of time or clear indicators it's hard to say what exactly they do; the highest risk of false positives.


Campaign: GENERIC-other-risky
